violations.text: The 3-bay sink sanitizer dispenser was observed in poor repair. Per PIC, service is scheduled for tomorrow. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

The wall/ceiling above the 2-bay sink was observed with spray foam. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. Per PIC, foam will be cut down and sealed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was observed over 400 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200-400 ppm. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The door to the outside, located in the main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. -Walk-in cooler fans -Equipment upstairs and downstairs (dust from construction) Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the upstairs service area, and downstairs ware washing area do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the upstairs and basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

-The service area counter was observed not installed -The wall by the down stairs hand sink was observed in poor repair -The ceiling by the ware washing area was observed with holes The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
